label: EquiformerV3+DeNS-OMat (direct)
elements: Li, Be, B, C, Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S
notes:
Stage-1 checkpoint of the same mirror-physics/equiformer_v3 series: direct pre-training on OMat24 only, before the gradient fine-tuning that produces omat24_gradient.pt and then the OAM omat24-mptrj-salex_gradient.pt.  Forces come from a direct head (use-gate-force-head), not from the energy gradient, so this is the non-conservative member of the family.
  The published omat24_direct.pt was saved from a torch.compile'd model, so every key carries an '_orig_mod.' prefix.  fairchem's match_state_dict counts the substring 'module' and strips 7 characters per level, which turns '_orig_mod.module.X' into 'od.module.X' and fails the load; the checkpoint used here is the same file with that prefix removed (weights untouched) -- see omat24_direct-uncompiled.pt next to the original download.

datasets.label: OMat24
datasets.notes: Open Materials 2024 (Meta FAIR): >100M structures from perturbing Alexandria structures.
